name: Lamb Shank Haleem with Barley and Lentils
description: A curated lamb shank haleem built with Pakistani spice logic and French braising technique. Whole shanks are seared and slow-braised until collagen-rich, then pulled and folded into pearl barley and split lentils spiced with garam masala. Halal, deeply satisfying, made for a weekend.
keywords: lamb shank haleem, halal haleem recipe, lamb shank barley stew, tagine haleem, Pakistani haleem, barley lentil stew
recipeIngredient: 2 lamb shanks (approx. 1.2 kg / 2 lb 10 oz total)
1 large onion, halved and thinly sliced
1.2 litres (5 cups) water or light lamb stock
120 g (2/3 cup) pearl barley, soaked 1 hour and drained
80 g (1/3 cup) chana dal, soaked 30 minutes and drained
60 g (1/4 cup) masoor dal (red split lentils)
Fresh ginger julienned, green chillies, fresh coriander, lemon wedges to serve

recipeInstructions.name: Sear the shanks
recipeInstructions.text: Pat lamb shanks dry. Heat oil in a heavy Dutch oven over high heat until shimmering. Sear shanks on all sides until deeply browned, 8 to 10 minutes. Remove and set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Build the masala
recipeInstructions.text: Reduce heat to medium. Cook sliced onion in the same pot until deep mahogany, 18 to 22 minutes. Add garlic and ginger, stir 90 seconds. Add cumin seeds, coriander seeds, turmeric, Kashmiri chilli, and salt. Stir 1 minute.

recipeInstructions.name: Braise the shanks
recipeInstructions.text: Return shanks to pot. Add water or stock. Bring to a boil, skim foam, reduce to a gentle simmer. Cover and cook for 2 hours, turning shanks once halfway, until meat is falling off the bone.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook grains and lentils
recipeInstructions.text: In a separate pot, combine drained barley, chana dal, and masoor dal with 900 ml water and 1 tsp salt. Bring to a boil, reduce to a simmer, cover and cook 45 to 55 minutes until all are completely soft.

recipeInstructions.name: Pull the meat
recipeInstructions.text: Lift shanks from pot. Remove bones. Shred meat with two forks. Reserve braising liquid.

recipeInstructions.name: Combine
recipeInstructions.text: Add cooked grain mixture and pulled meat to the braising pot. Stir to combine. Adjust consistency with reserved liquid or water. Cook uncovered over medium heat, stirring, if too thin.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish seasoning
recipeInstructions.text: Stir in garam masala, kasuri methi, ghee, and lemon juice. Taste and adjust salt. Cook on low heat for 5 minutes, stirring constantly.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the tarka
recipeInstructions.text: In a small frying pan, heat oil over medium-high. Cook sliced onion until crisp and deep brown, 10 to 12 minutes. Add dried chillies and cumin seeds, stir 30 seconds. Pour over haleem.

recipeInstructions.name: Serve
recipeInstructions.text: Ladle into bowls. Top with julienned ginger, green chillies, and fresh coriander. Serve with lemon wedges.
